original_submission.content:
import os
import subprocess

def main():
    print("--- INITIATING FINAL PRE-FLIGHT CHECK (v1.1) ---")
    checker_script = "storage/telos/repro_kit/pre_flight_checker.py"
    script_to_check = "storage/telos/temp/rs_s10_verification_draft.py"
    
    if not os.path.exists(checker_script) or not os.path.exists(script_to_check):
        print("FATAL: A required script for the check is missing.")
        return

    print(f"Target: {script_to_check}")
    
    result = subprocess.run(['python', checker_script, script_to_check], capture_output=True, text=True)
    
    print("\n--- CHECKER OUTPUT ---")
    print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr:
        print("\n--- CHECKER STDERR ---")
        print(result.stderr)
    
    if result.returncode == 0:
        print("\n--- CONCLUSION: Pre-flight check PASSED. Main script is cleared for submission. ---")
    else:
        print("\n--- CONCLUSION: Pre-flight check FAILED. Main script requires correction. ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
